title: Import Data
subtitle: Upload a CSV to add people or opening balances. Nothing is committed until you confirm.

upload.title: Upload Source File
upload.hint: CSV, UTF-8, up to 10 MB and 2,000 rows.
upload.noFile: Choose a CSV file to upload.
upload.tooLarge: That file is larger than 10 MB. Split it and import the parts separately.
upload.wrongType: Choose a .csv file. Spreadsheets must be exported as CSV first.

processing.title: Validating…
processing.body: The file is being validated. This page updates automatically.

review.title: Row Review
review.blockedByRejections: This import has rejected rows and cannot be committed. Fix the source file and start a new import.

confirm.title: Confirm Commit
confirm.body: This will permanently apply {{accepted}} accepted rows. This cannot be undone.

committing.title: Committing…
committing.body: The import is being applied and reconciled. This page updates automatically.

result.title: Import Complete
result.reconciledBody: The import reached RECONCILED with {{committed}} rows committed.
result.failedBody: The import could not be committed.
result.deadLetterBody: This import was retired after repeated failures and will not be retried. Start a new import once the source file is corrected.
result.evidenceUnavailable: No source evidence is available to download for this import.

errors.statusFailed: Could not read the import job's status.
errors.downloadFailed: Could not download the source evidence.
errors.evidenceExpired: This evidence has expired and can no longer be downloaded.
errors.openFailed: Could not open that import job.

stalled: This is taking longer than expected. Refresh the page or check back shortly.

capabilityUnavailable.title: Data Import Not Available
capabilityUnavailable.body: Data import is not available for this organization yet. Contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

activeJob.body: This organization already has an import in progress. Resume it or cancel it before starting a new one.
activeJob.notFound: The blocking import is no longer listed. Reload the page and try again.
